description: This file is the main application source file for an iOS app written in Swift. It defines the application delegate, scene handling, background task management, and notification handling. It includes classes and functions for handling push notifications, background refresh tasks, and interactions with watch prompts, as well as the main app struct that sets up the app's environment and scene.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: Application delegate class handling app lifecycle events, push notification registration, background tasks, and scene phase changes for the iOS app.

classes.name: WatchPromptNotificationBridge
classes.description: Utility struct for managing notification categories, actions, and scheduling for watch prompt notifications.

methods.name: application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)
methods.description: Initializes background tasks, sets notification delegate, and registers for remote notifications on app launch.

methods.name: application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
methods.description: Handles successful remote notification registration by updating the app model with the device token.

methods.name: application(_:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:)
methods.description: Logs an error if remote notification registration fails.

methods.name: application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Processes incoming remote notifications, potentially waking the app to handle silent pushes.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged(_:)
methods.description: Triggers background refresh scheduling when scene moves to background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask()
methods.description: Registers the background wake refresh task with the system.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh(afterSeconds:reason:)
methods.description: Schedules a background task with a specified delay and reason.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh(task:)
methods.description: Handles the background wake refresh operation, rescheduling itself and managing app model wake calls.

methods.name: parseWatchPromptAction(from:)
methods.description: Parses notification response to detect watch prompt actions.

methods.name: routeWatchPromptAction(_:)
methods.description: Routes the parsed watch prompt action to the app model for handling.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:willPresent:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles presentation options for incoming notifications, giving special cases for watch prompts.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles user responses to notifications, routing watch prompt actions accordingly.
